title: HVAC Maintenance Agreements Tune-Up Allotment and Seasonal Windows by Level
content:
Each level of the HVAC Maintenance Agreements grants a set number of tune-up visits per enrolled system per term and schedules them within fixed seasonal windows. Months are given as calendar month numbers.

| Agreement level | Visits per system per term | Cooling tune-up included | Heating tune-up included | Cooling window | Heating window | Minimum days between two tune-ups of one system in a term | Unused visits carry into next term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential | 1 | Yes | No | month 3 through month 6 | month 9 through month 12 | 120 | No |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Standard | 2 | Yes | Yes | month 3 through month 6 | month 9 through month 12 | 120 | No |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus | 2 | Yes | Yes | month 3 through month 6 | month 9 through month 12 | 120 | No |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System | 2 | Yes | Yes | month 3 through month 6 | month 9 through month 12 | 120 | No |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System Plus | 2 | Yes | Yes | month 3 through month 6 | month 9 through month 12 | 120 | No |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier | 2 | Yes | Yes | month 3 through month 6 | month 9 through month 12 | 120 | No |

## Definitions of the figures

- **Visits per system per term**: tune-up visits per enrolled system per term.
- **Cooling tune-up included** and **heating tune-up included**: whether a cooling-season tune-up, and whether a heating-season tune-up, is included.
- **Cooling window**: the first calendar month (month 3, March) and the last calendar month (month 6, June) in which cooling tune-ups are scheduled.
- **Heating window**: the first calendar month (month 9, September) and the last calendar month (month 12, December) in which heating tune-ups are scheduled.
- **Minimum days between two tune-ups**: the minimum number of calendar days, 120, between two tune-ups of the same system in a term.
- **Unused visits carry into next term**: whether unused visits carry into the next term; on every level they do not.

## Distinguishing the levels

Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential grants one visit per system per term and includes the cooling-season tune-up only; its heating window figures are stated in its parameters, but a heating-season tune-up is not included on that level. Every other level grants two visits per system per term and includes both a cooling-season and a heating-season tune-up. The windows, the 120-day spacing and the absence of carryover are the same on all six levels.

## Illustration (hypothetical agreement)

A hypothetical Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus agreement with two enrolled systems holds two visits for each system in a term. For either system, a cooling tune-up falls in March, April, May or June and a heating tune-up in September, October, November or December, at least 120 calendar days after that system's earlier tune-up in the same term.
